senses.gloss:
ITA-5.75.18 śramaśvāsavegarodhaḥ श्रमश्वासवेगरोधः
Disorder due to withholding of breath on exertion
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: palpable glandular enlargement in the abdomen/abdominal lump; heart diseases; unconsciousness/confusion.

ITA-5.76.105 atidurbala; kṣutārta ttṝṣṇārta; śramārtānāM āsthāpanasya vyāpadaḥ अतिदुर्बल; क्षुतार्त त्तॄष्णार्त; श्रमार्तानां आस्थापनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by medicated decoction enema administered to person who is extremely emaciated and weak
A condition characterized by instantaneous emaciation of body.

ITA-5.76.27 śrāntapipāsitakṣudhiteṣu vamanasya vyāpadaḥ श्रान्तपिपासितक्षुधितेषु वमनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by emetic therapy administered to person who is tired, thirsty and hungry
A condition characterized by mental damage.

ITA-5.76.147 śrāmārtamattamūrcchitānāma nasya vyāpadaḥ श्रामार्तमत्तमूर्च्छितानाम नस्य व्यापदः
Condition due to inhalation therapy administered to person with fatigue; intoxication or syncope

ITA-6.2.6.12 sraṃsana-karma स्रंसन-कर्म
Mild laxative
A type of purgative which does not allow unformed excreta to adhere to the alimentary canal but expels them.

ITA-5.66.60 srāvaḥ स्रावः
Epiphora
A disorder characterized by discharge at the inner canthus; painless discharge.
